name: Athena
description: Goddess of wisdom, strategy, and skilled crafts.
rationale: A deliberately interpretive portrait emphasizing strategic thinking, discipline, and composure.

name: Zeus
description: King of the gods, associated with the sky, authority, and thunder.
rationale: An interpretive portrait emphasizing visibility, ambition, and assertive leadership; not a moral endorsement.

name: Hermes
description: Messenger of the gods, associated with travel, language, and trade.
rationale: An interpretive portrait emphasizing curiosity, adaptability, and sociability.

name: Artemis
description: Goddess of the hunt, wilderness, and wild animals.
rationale: An interpretive portrait emphasizing independence, focus, and self-reliance.

name: Apollo
description: God associated with music, healing, poetry, and prophecy.
rationale: An interpretive portrait emphasizing creativity, skill development, and expressiveness.

name: Aphrodite
description: Goddess of beauty, love, and desire.
rationale: An interpretive portrait emphasizing relational warmth, aesthetic sensitivity, and social influence.

name: Ares
description: God associated with war, conflict, and courage.
rationale: An interpretive portrait emphasizing intensity, impulsivity, and competitive drive; not a moral endorsement.

name: Demeter
description: Goddess of agriculture, harvest, and nourishment.
rationale: An interpretive portrait emphasizing responsibility, care, loyalty, and emotional investment.

name: Hera
description: Queen of the gods; associated with marriage and royal authority.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes dignity, loyalty, duty, and resistance to betrayal.

name: Poseidon
description: God of the sea, earthquakes, and horses.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes forceful independence, intensity, and emotional volatility.

name: Hades
description: God and ruler of the realm of the dead.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes reserve, steadfastness, privacy, and persistence.

name: Hestia
description: Goddess of the hearth and home.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes steadiness, care, humility, and tranquility.

name: Hephaestus
description: God of smithing, craftsmanship, and fire.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes technical ingenuity, perseverance, and reserved focus.

name: Dionysus
description: God associated with wine, festivals, theater, and ecstasy.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes creative experimentation, expressiveness, and spontaneity.

name: Persephone
description: Goddess associated with spring growth and queen of the underworld.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes adaptability, emotional insight, and transformation.

name: Hecate
description: Goddess of crossroads, magic, and liminal spaces.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes curiosity, self-reliance, and reflective caution.

name: Nike
description: Winged goddess personifying victory.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes focus, drive, competitiveness, and confidence.

name: Nemesis
description: Goddess personifying retribution and the balancing of excess.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes principles, accountability, and unyielding judgment.

name: Iris
description: Messenger goddess associated with the rainbow.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes communication, flexibility, and helpfulness.

name: Tyche
description: Goddess of fortune and changing luck.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes opportunism, adaptability, and openness to uncertainty.

name: Hebe
description: Goddess of youth and cupbearer of the gods.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes warmth, cooperation, and spirited sociability.

name: Eos
description: Goddess of the dawn.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes optimism, initiative, and renewal.

name: Selene
description: Goddess personifying the moon.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes contemplation, inward focus, and imaginative sensitivity.

name: Leto
description: Mother of Apollo and Artemis; a revered goddess in Greek myth.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes endurance, maternal care, and resilience.

name: Rhea
description: Titaness associated with motherhood and the generation of Olympian gods.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes protectiveness, patience, and steadfast affection.

name: Gaia
description: Primordial goddess and personification of the Earth.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes nurturance, stability, and long-range perspective.

name: Nyx
description: Primordial goddess personifying Night.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes depth, mystery, autonomy, and reflection.

name: Themis
description: Titaness associated with divine law, order, and custom.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes fairness, self-discipline, and consistent principles.

name: Dike
description: Goddess personifying justice.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes ethical consistency, attention to rules, and equity.

name: Eris
description: Goddess personifying discord and strife.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes confrontation, provocation, and independence.

name: Harmonia
description: Goddess personifying harmony and concord.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes diplomacy, cooperation, and social balance.

name: Amphitrite
description: Sea goddess and consort of Poseidon.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes poise, steadiness, and quiet influence.

name: Eileithyia
description: Goddess of childbirth and labor.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes compassion, responsibility, and supportive care.

name: Helios
description: Sun god who drives the solar chariot across the sky.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes consistency, visibility, duty, and purpose.

name: Hypnos
description: God personifying sleep.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes calm, gentleness, and unhurried reflection.

name: Thanatos
description: God personifying nonviolent death.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes reserve, inevitability, and emotional restraint.

name: Morpheus
description: Dream deity associated with shaping human forms in dreams.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes imagination, observation, and quiet creativity.

name: Pan
description: God of the wild, shepherds, flocks, and rustic music.

name: Asclepius
description: God of healing and medicine.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes careful inquiry, service, and methodical skill.

name: Triton
description: Sea god often described as a herald of Poseidon.

name: Proteus
description: Shape-shifting old sea god and prophetic figure.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes adaptability, insight, and privacy.

name: Phobos

name: Deimos
description: Divine personification of dread or terror.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes intensity, forceful presence, and unease.

name: Prometheus
description: Titan associated with foresight and the gift of fire to humanity.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes inventiveness, conviction, and concern for others.

name: Atlas
description: Titan condemned to hold up the heavens.
rationale: Author-designed archetype interpretation: Emphasizes endurance, burden-bearing, and reliability.
